title: Renewal of Expired 1-Year and 3-Year Plans — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Renewal.** A customer whose month-based alignment plan of Alignment Services & Plans (Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan) has expired may renew it. A renewal is a new plan of the same line for the same vehicle, bought by the customer at the renewal price, with an expiration date of the purchase date plus the line's term in months, counted as calendar months to the same day of the month (falling back to the last day of that month). The vehicle must still be inside the line's list of eligible vehicle classes and in personal use.

> A renewal is priced only after every readjustment under the expired plan dated the renewal day carries its guarantee basis.

**Price.** For a renewal of an expired month-based plan sold under this policy, and only for such a renewal, the purchase price is the renewal price in place of the tire bundle price; a renewal is never charged to a Crestline Fleet Account, and no fleet discount is combined with it. Every plan that is neither a renewal nor a household plan is priced at the line's plan price less its tire bundle discount when a Crestline tire set was installed on the same vehicle within the tire bundle window before the purchase date (that date included), and at the plan price otherwise, the bundle discount never combined with a fleet discount and a fleet account's discount applying on a fleet ticket only where the line allows it.

**Purchase-visit alignment.** For a renewal sold under this policy, and only for such a renewal, the first alignment is performed on the purchase visit as an included alignment unless the vehicle received a guarantee readjustment under the expired plan on the renewal date, in which case that readjustment stands as the visit's alignment and no second alignment is performed. Every plan that is neither a renewal nor a household plan keeps its purchase-visit alignment.

*Hypothetical expiration dates:* a renewal bought on 14 June of a 12-month line expires on 14 June of the following year; one bought on 31 May of a 36-month line expires on 31 May three years later.

## The customer's renewal: `renew_alignment_plan_418ab11e`

**Capability.** The customer renews their own expired month-based alignment plan at the renewal price the agent quoted. On success a new active alignment plan of the same line and customer as the expired plan is created for the given vehicle, dated today, with the expiration date, purchase odometer, tender and price given and a newly issued store ticket number; the expired plan itself is left as it is, and the customer sees the new plan on their profile.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `renew_alignment_plan_418ab11e` and hands it over to the customer; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
- `expired_plan_id` — reference number of the customer's expired month-based alignment plan being renewed, from the alignment plan lookup (text).
- `vehicle_id` — reference number of the vehicle the expired plan was valid on and the renewal is bought for, from the vehicle lookup (text).
- `store_id` — reference number of the Crestline store the renewal is sold through, from the store lookup (text).
- `purchase_odometer` — odometer of the vehicle on the renewal date, integer miles, as written on that vehicle's work order of the day.
- `expiration_date` — last day of the new plan's term, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD.
- `payment_method` — tender the customer pays with: `cash_or_debit` (cash or a debit card) or `bank_card` (an outside bank credit card); `crestline_card` and `fleet_account` are not accepted, because tickets on those accounts post through them.
- `purchase_price` — price of the renewal, USD with 2 decimal places, before tax; rounded to the nearest cent by the tool when more digits are given.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `alignment_plan_id` (the new plan), `variant_name` (the line taken from the expired plan), `vehicle_id`, `status` (the text active), `purchase_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `expiration_date`, `purchase_ticket_number` (T- followed by 8 digits) and `purchase_price`. A tender outside the accepted values, or an `expired_plan_id` that is unknown, returns a text starting with "Error:" and changes nothing.
